original_test_intent: Run the specified AGHFC single-pass GPU health/stress suite, prove every expected subtest passes without system issue, and determine whether unexpected fan events occur during the run.
original_method: Install an immutable reviewed AGHFC build, verify target topology/config and output path, execute the literal single_pass command once under an external watchdog and thermal/power monitoring, parse the complete subtest roster and correlate timestamped fan/SEL/BMC/OS logs.
manual_activity: GPU/platform owner approves the AGHFC artifact, expected subtests and fan-event rules, supervises OOB/abort recovery and sets verdict.
required_inputs: Pinned AGHFC artifact/version/checksum/license and install recipe
Fan inventory, normal stress fan behavior and unexpected-event oracle
Power/thermal limits, external timeout, abort/OOB and cleanup plan
safety_requirements: Verify artifact and isolated install before execution
Confirm all GPUs/cooling/power and independent OOB
Wrap disabled internal timeout with approved external deadline
Abort once on threshold, hang, driver reset or unexpected event; do not automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Preflight approved artifact/topology and log path
Run exact command once inside independent supervision
Capture every expected subtest and correlated fan/health timeline
engineer_actions: Approve artifact, roster, fan-event semantics and safety limits
Review complete results/events and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Hash the tool/config, snapshot pre-run fan/SEL state, execute under OOB watchdog, then reconcile expected subtests and fan events against a shared monotonic timeline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes all-pass and fan-event criteria complete and prevents `--disable-timeout` from creating an unbounded run.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No shorter smoke test, other AGFHC level or generic GPU stress substitutes for this command.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fan speed increases may be normal under stress; only the approved event/severity oracle distinguishes expected response from fault.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must define the authoritative AGHFC revision and subtest roster plus which fan event codes/severities are expected, prohibited or informational.
expected_evidence: Approved artifact checksum/install/version and topology preflight
Exact command, external watchdog policy, stdout/stderr/exit/timing
Complete expected-versus-observed subtest result table and output-tree hashes
Fan sensor/event/SEL/BMC/OS timeline against approved oracle
Abort/recovery/cleanup record, dispositions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: AGHFC/AGFHC spelling varies, but the source item, executable and single_pass intent are consistently identifiable; DeepSeek is incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Artifact, oracle and critical safety approval are supplyable prerequisites.

review_improvement: Retains the exact disabled-timeout AGHFC coverage while bounding it externally and defining complete subtest and fan-event evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: `--disable-timeout` transfers hang control away from the suite, so process supervision must be independent of the stressed driver/GPU and able to recover through OOB. 'All pass' also requires a known expected subtest roster; otherwise skipped tests can disappear. Fan events need time correlation and a platform-specific severity oracle because increased cooling activity is not automatically a fault.
